prayerGuides.title: Consecration and Fresh Commitment to God
prayerGuides.introduction: Prayer Focus: Seeking God's help, wisdom and grace concerning my devotion and consecration. Use these prayer points to renew your commitment to God, deepen your fellowship with Him and seek His grace to live a life that is fully surrendered to His will.

prayerPoints.title: Deeper fellowship with God
prayerPoints.description: Father, draw me/us into deeper fellowship with You as I/we consider my devotion and consecration; let my/our relationship with You remain the foundation of every step.

prayerPoints.title: Removal of ungodly influences
prayerPoints.description: Lord, expose and remove every attitude, habit or influence that works against Your will concerning my devotion and consecration.

prayerPoints.title: Grace for complete obedience
prayerPoints.description: Grant me/us grace to obey Your Word promptly, completely and consistently in my devotion and consecration, even when obedience is costly.

prayerPoints.title: Fulfilment of God's promises
prayerPoints.description: Let the promises of Scripture concerning my devotion and consecration become evident in my/our life, family and community, according to Your will.

prayerPoints.description: Give me/us wisdom to recognise the right choices, opportunities and relationships connected with my devotion and consecration.

prayerPoints.title: Strength for the weary
prayerPoints.description: Strengthen everyone who is weary or discouraged concerning my devotion and consecration; renew hope, courage and steadfast faith.

prayerPoints.title: Victory over obstacles
prayerPoints.description: Help me/us overcome every obstacle contrary to Your purpose in my devotion and consecration, and show me/us the godly steps to take.

prayerPoints.title: Protection from deception
prayerPoints.description: Protect me/us from deception, error, harmful counsel and decisions that could derail Your purpose in my devotion and consecration.

prayerPoints.title: Growth in Christlike character
prayerPoints.description: Build integrity, humility, patience and Christlike character in me/us as I/we grow in my devotion and consecration.

prayerPoints.title: Peace in relationships
prayerPoints.description: Let Your peace rule in my/our heart, home, church and relationships as we address my devotion and consecration; remove strife and cultivate understanding.

prayerPoints.title: God-ordained opportunities
prayerPoints.description: Open doors that align with Your purpose in my devotion and consecration, and give me/us discernment to refuse what is not from You.

prayerPoints.title: Fruitfulness and usefulness
prayerPoints.description: Make my/our life fruitful and useful to others through my devotion and consecration; let every blessing received become a blessing to many.

prayerPoints.title: Compassion for the vulnerable
prayerPoints.description: Remember those who are vulnerable, overlooked or struggling in this area; raise helpers and make me/us compassionate instruments of Your grace.

prayerPoints.title: Completion of God's good work
prayerPoints.description: Let every good work You have begun in me/us concerning my devotion and consecration mature and produce lasting fruit for Your glory.

prayerPoints.title: Thanksgiving and continued faithfulness
prayerPoints.description: Father, receive my/our thanksgiving; help me/us remain faithful concerning my devotion and consecration and give You all the glory for every answer.
